test: [INV-SCH-09] falsifier: three days offline do not move the chip or the fraction
what: Three days offline decay around 180 items below the mastery threshold and the learner completes a lesson. Score computed from live retrievability walks backwards, which takes a number away from somebody for not opening an app. Score is learned, not remembered (EC-HUB-07); strength bars are the surface that renders retrievability, and they say Ready to review.
measured: 2026-09-11. Sixty mastered items, every row then forced to stability 1 and retrievability 0.1: points, fractionToNext and masteredCount are all unchanged. The mastery high-water mark additionally survives a mastery threshold raised in a later release.
scale: The chip is `points / 160`. 160 is the corpus scale (blog.duolingo.com/duolingo-score 2024-10-23, via deep/04:147 and deep/02:98); the numerator is clamped to the installed pack's declared ceiling per EC-PACK-55 ('a chip reading `29 / 160`'), which is injected as `PackScoreCeiling`. A `SCORE_MAX = 150` carrying a fabricated `[obs 2026-09-10]` tag stood here in the first draft and is gone.
